description: This file contains providers and state management logic for handling doctors data in a Flutter app, utilizing Riverpod for dependency injection and state management, and Dio for network requests.

classes.name: DoctorsState
classes.description: Immutable class representing the state of doctors data, including list of doctors, loading status, errors, and filter.

classes.name: DoctorsController
classes.description: StateNotifier managing loading, filtering, and error states related to doctors data, interacting with DoctorsRepository.

methods.name: loadDoctors
methods.description: Fetches a list of doctors from the repository with an optional specialty filter, handles loading state and errors.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters the list of doctors by specialty and reloads data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reloads the current list of doctors using the existing filter.

methods.name: DoctorsState.initial
methods.description: Creates an initial DoctorsState instance with default values.

methods.name: _friendlyError
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message from a DioException.
